pieces.title: Hear the word: speak the asked form on the review screen

steps.title: The voice rule on both apps: chooseVoice, SPEECH_RATE, golden/speech.json
steps.why: Sonnet: one small pure function, and the golden cases hold the two apps to the same answers mechanically.

steps.title: Android: TtsSpeaker, manifest queries, debug RecordingSpeaker, AppHarness fake, the review button and its tests
steps.why: Sonnet: a contained change to one screen in a pattern the app already uses; high effort because it spans three test layers and a device-only API.

steps.title: Web: SpeechPlatform over speechSynthesis, the e2e fake, the review button and its tests
steps.why: Sonnet: mirrors build-2 in the web's Platform and fake pattern; high effort because the iOS keyboard rule (focus, never remount) is easy to break.

steps.title: The shared Hearing the word scenario, docs and changelog
steps.why: Sonnet: two new steps on existing patterns, plus prose.

steps.title: Review the whole piece
steps.why: Sonnet: a small piece with no data or reminder risk, held together by golden cases and a shared scenario; high effort for both apps and the on-device-voices privacy rule.

pieces.title: Apply a review in domain: one golden-tested rule for both apps, Android's review write in one transaction

steps.title: The rule on both apps: reviewed() in domain, golden/review.json and both runners
steps.why: Opus: the step's whole point is that both apps agree (goal 5), and its golden cases must pin today's scheduling exactly (goal 4); medium effort for one pure function lifted from existing code on each side.

steps.title: Both repositories apply it; Android's recordReview by id in one Room transaction, deleted word records nothing; tests, CLAUDE.md, changelog
steps.why: Opus: changes how Android writes a review (goal 1), adds a Room transaction, and changes a repository signature the review screen calls.

steps.title: Review the whole piece
steps.why: Opus: the piece touches goal 1 (a transaction around the review write) and must keep both apps in agreement; medium effort for two build steps with no UI.

pieces.title: Design the app icon in house with Recraft: explore styles, Alan picks a direction and a final, rebuild it as the generated icons

steps.title: Recraft client with a spend cap, the sheet renderer, the explore round and its contact sheet; blocks for Alan to pick a direction
steps.why: Opus: spends paid units against a hard cap with a new API client, and the step's worth is judging which designs to show Alan; medium effort as the code is small.

steps.title: Two refine rounds in the chosen direction and a finalists sheet; blocks for Alan to pick the final
steps.why: Opus: design judgement and prompt tightening against the criteria, spending paid units; medium effort with the tools already built.

steps.title: The generator reads scripts/icon-source.svg: parser, flattener, outputs and geometry tests, on today's shapes
steps.why: Sonnet: a contained Node script with exact tests; high effort for the path flattener and the contour-distance rules.

steps.title: Rebuild the pick as clean paths in the source, every output, web icons, final side-by-side, changelog (or the fallback)
steps.why: Opus: hand-building art from a traced reference to pass strict geometry and look as good at 24 dp, including the reminder's notification icon (goal 2); high effort for visual iteration.

steps.title: Review the whole piece
steps.why: Opus: the notification icon is the reminder's face (goal 2) and the piece spent paid units; medium effort for a piece with no data or behaviour change.

pieces.title: Edit a word from review after a miss: a saved edit undoes the miss and the word is asked again
Warn about suspect forms (a space in a one-word root's form) after a paste and in the word list
